agent.label: Ask the AI
agent.description: An agent reads, thinks and writes.

condition.label: If… then…
condition.description: Picks a path according to a rule.

api-get.label: Read data from an API
api-get.description: Calls a web address and gets the answer.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Lets a delay pass before the next step.

human.label: Ask for approval
human.description: A person approves or refuses before the workflow goes on.

response.label: Reply
response.description: Returns the final result of the workflow.

email.label: Send an email
email.description: Sends a message through your email server.

slack.label: Slack message
slack.description: Posts a message in a Slack channel.

teams.label: Teams message
teams.description: Posts a message in Microsoft Teams.

sms.label: Send a text message
sms.description: Sends a text to a phone number.

table-add.label: Add a row to a table
table-add.description: Saves a row in a workspace table.

table-read.label: Read a table
table-read.description: Finds rows in a workspace table.

knowledge.label: Search the knowledge
knowledge.description: Finds the useful passages of a knowledge base.

extract.label: Extract from a document
extract.description: Reads an invoice or a form and pulls fields out of it.

file.label: Read a file
file.description: Gets the content of a workspace file.

variables.label: Remember a value
variables.description: Keeps a value for the next steps.

transcription.label: Transcribe a recording
transcription.description: Turns an audio recording into text.

speech.label: Read a text aloud
speech.description: Produces an audio file from a text.

translate.label: Translate
translate.description: Translates a text into another language.

connect.label: Nexora Connect action
connect.description: Acts in one of your connected services.

subworkflow.label: Run another workflow
subworkflow.description: Reuses an existing workflow as a step.

function.label: JavaScript calculation
function.description: Applies a small calculation or transformation.

view.title: Steps
view.emptyBranch: Nothing to do in this case
view.removeWithBranches: Delete the condition and its {count} steps

readOnly.title: Read only
readOnly.body: This workflow is organized in a way the Steps view cannot edit safely. You can read it here; to edit it, open it in the canvas.

refusal.unknown-block: It contains an advanced block the step catalog does not cover.
refusal.disabled-block: One of its blocks is disabled.
refusal.locked-block: One of its blocks is locked.
refusal.subflow: It contains a loop or a parallel run.
refusal.extra-edges: Its links are not a simple sequence of steps.
refusal.unreachable: Some blocks are not linked to any step.
refusal.branch-in-branch: A condition sits inside the branch of another condition.

view.editFailed: This change could not be made.
view.agentNotReady: The models are not ready yet: try again in a moment.
view.removeConfirm: This condition holds {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}: they will be deleted with it.

test.title: Test
test.sampleDataHint: These values replace what the trigger would receive. They are kept with the workflow.
test.noInputs: This trigger expects no data: run the test directly.
test.inputsWebhook: Testing a webhook uses an example payload.
test.fixHint: Fix the step, then run the test again.

errors.missingFields: The step “{block}” is not complete: {fields} is missing. Open it and fill these fields in.
errors.budget: The workspace's monthly token budget is reached. Ask an administrator to raise it.
errors.modelNotFound: The chosen model does not exist or is no longer available. Pick another model in the step.
errors.timeout: The step took too long to answer. Try again, or simplify the request.
errors.egress: This address is blocked by the instance security. An administrator must allow it in the network settings.
errors.auth: The remote service refused access: check the key or the connection this step uses.
errors.notFound: The address called does not exist (error 404). Check it.
errors.rateLimit: The remote service limits the number of requests. Wait a moment before running again.
errors.server: The remote service is down or overloaded. Try again later.
errors.network: The remote service cannot be reached. Check the address and the network connection.
errors.json: The answer received is not in the expected format (invalid JSON).
errors.reference: This step reads a value that does not exist: check the names of the steps and fields it mentions.
errors.smtp: The email server refused the connection. Check it in Settings › Email.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred in this step.

toolbar.otherBlocksTooltip: All the other core blocks, alphabetically.
toolbar.connectTooltip: Act in more than 1,600 connected services with a single block.
toolbar.directIntegrationsTooltip: One block per service, with its own settings. Nexora Connect already covers most of these services.
